title: Agent Ledger Entry
description: Schema for a single entry in the organizational Agent Ledger. The Ledger is the cognitive accounting system of the agentic economy — it records not just what the agent did, but why and how. Part of the Agentic Governance Framework by Indira Réquiz, 2026.

entry_id.description: Unique identifier for this Ledger entry. Format: {org_slug}/ledger/{yyyymmdd}/{uuid}

agent_identity.description: Full organizational identity of the agent — not just model name.

agent_id.description: Agent's unique ID in the organizational registry

permissions_at_execution.description: Exact permission set active during this task execution

task_objective.description: What the agent was trying to achieve — in verifiable operational terms.

description.description: Operational description of the task. Not the raw prompt — the distilled objective.

success_criteria.description: Explicit definition of what constitutes successful completion

amp_task_id.description: AMP task_id if this task was initiated via an AMP message

documented_reasoning.description: The reasoning trace — this is what transforms a trajectory log into a decision trace.

alternatives_considered.description: Alternative approaches considered and why they were rejected

critical_decision_points.description: Moments where the agent chose between meaningfully different paths

tools_used.description: All tools and external systems accessed during task execution

result.description: The output — anchored to the reasoning chain above.

output_ref.description: Reference to the output artifact (URI, file path, or inline if small)

output_summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was produced

validation.description: How the output was validated. Applies the principle of validator independence.

validator_independence.description: Was the validator a different model/system from the producer? Required for LAYER_3+

validator_model.description: Model used for cross-model validation (if applicable)

risk_level.description:
Risk classification that determines Ledger granularity.
- CRITICAL: irreversible high-impact action → full trace
- RELEVANT: reversible medium-impact → standard entry
- ROUTINE: low-impact or repeated → compressed hash entry

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of task execution

safe_mode_activated.description: Whether Safe Mode was triggered during this task

integrity_hash.description: Optional: cryptographic hash of this entry for immutability verification (recommended for CRITICAL entries)

task_objective.description: Generate Q1 2026 revenue analysis by product line with YoY comparison
task_objective.success_criteria: Report includes revenue by product line, YoY comparison, and at least 3 variance explanations

intermediate_steps.action: Query Snowflake for Q1 2026 revenue by product
intermediate_steps.rationale: Primary data source specified in task

intermediate_steps.action: Query Snowflake for Q1 2025 revenue for YoY baseline
intermediate_steps.rationale: Required for comparison as per success criteria

intermediate_steps.action: Calculate variance and identify top 3 drivers

alternatives_considered: Using cached monthly reports instead of direct query — rejected: may not reflect end-of-period adjustments

critical_decision_points.choice_made: Convert all to USD at period-average exchange rate

result.output_summary: Q1 revenue $12.4M, up 18% YoY. Top variance drivers: new enterprise tier (+$2.1M), EU expansion (+$800K), churn in SMB segment (-$300K).
